series_short_description: Scales, Tails, and Safe People — From a panicked seventeen-year-old mistake at Northwood High and her non-verbal cousin Wesley's heartbreak to raising disabled twins Jonas and Nora and building North Lion Scales & Tails in Maplewood, Minnesota.
series_description: The Story of Heather Lindstrom: Scales, Tails, and Safe People follows Heather Lindstrom (née Collins) from Chesapeake and Virginia Beach to Maplewood, Minnesota. When seventeen-year-old Heather panics over a classmate's malicious rumor in January 2003 and ends her relationship with sixteen-year-old Nathaniel Prairie without letting him speak, her fifteen-year-old non-verbal cousin Wesley erupts in furious, terrified heartbreak at losing his very first guy friend. Stepping up at nineteen as Wesley's legal guardian, marrying wildlife biologist Dan Lindstrom, raising severely disabled fraternal twins Jonas and Nora alongside fiercely protective younger daughter Molly, and spending ten quiet years behind the camera lens before opening the barrier-free North Lion Scales & Tails Reptile Zoo, Heather learns what it truly takes to become a safe person.
